request.spec:
The sheet's settings assign a role to a user name: clerk (the default for any name) or steward
(ROLE_SET user=<name> role=<role>). The sheet also has a clerk limit (two decimals; blank means no
limit; SETTING_CHANGED key=clerk-limit value=<limit>). A clerk can settle a claim only when its
due is at or below the limit; above it, settling is refused with an error on the claim. A claim
whose due is n/a is within any limit. Stewards settle anything. The opener still cannot settle
their own claim.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The sheet's settings assign a role to a user name: clerk (the default for any name) or steward
(ROLE_SET user=<name> role=<role>). The sheet also has a clerk limit (two decimals; blank means no
limit; SETTING_CHANGED key=clerk-limit value=<limit>). A clerk can settle a claim only when its
due is at or below the limit; above it, settling is refused with an error on the claim. A claim

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Roles and the clerk limit are in, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

**Stored data** (`V18__role_clerk_limit.sql`)
- A new `sheet_role` table holds one role per user name on each sheet, either `clerk` or `steward`. A name with no row is a clerk.
- A new `sheet.clerk_limit` column holds the limit with two decimals. Empty means no limit.

**Server**
- **Roles:** `GET` and `PUT /api/sheets/{sheetId}/roles`. Any role other than clerk or steward is refused and nothing is written. A successful change writes `ROLE_SET … user=<name> role=<role>` to the audit file.
- **Settings:** `GET` and `PUT /api/sheets/{sheetId}/settings`. The limit must be an amount with up to two decimals, or blank for no limit. Every save writes `SETTING_CHANGED … key=clerk-limit value=<limit>`, even when the value hasn't changed — one of the tests expects that.
- **Settling:** `SaveClaimStatus` now refuses when a clerk tries to settle a claim whose due is above the limit. The error shows on the claim. It checks the due the screen shows: the figure from the person's last statement if one applies, otherwise the current figure. A due of n/a, or no limit, always passes. Stewards can settle anything. The existing rule that whoever opened a claim can't settle it is checked first and still applies to everyone.

**Front end**
- **Settings section** (`features/settings/settings.slot.tsx`): shows the limit in force and has a field to change it. The field starts out holding the current value, so saving without typing anything keeps the limit as it is rather than clearing it.
- **Roles section** (`features/roles/roles.slot.tsx`): a user-name field, a role field, and the list of roles assigned so far. The role field is free text with suggestions rather than a dropdown, because the test types an invalid role ("boss") and expects to see the error.

Nobody is restricted from changing roles or the limit; any signed-in user can, as the tests do. Restricting this to stewards would be a separate change.
